subject.title: test: consolidate OpenClaw test state fixtures

question: Should this maintainer-labeled test refactor be accepted across all affected suites after the two failed check lanes are understood and the shared fixture’s teardown contract is confirmed for the stateful tests?
rationale: The branch deliberately centralizes lifecycle control across several independent test domains, and the protected label reserves that cross-cutting adoption decision for maintainer judgment.

options.title: Review and merge after checks
options.body: Confirm the failing boundary and dependency checks are unrelated or fix them, then merge if the fixture preserves all affected tests’ setup and teardown contracts.

options.title: Narrow the consolidation
options.body: Keep only clearly equivalent fixture conversions and leave specialized proxy, database, or workspace lifecycle setup local where its ordering is part of the test contract.

recommendation.title: Review and merge after checks
recommendation.body: Confirm the failing boundary and dependency checks are unrelated or fix them, then merge if the fixture preserves all affected tests’ setup and teardown contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned contributor and supplied the stated validation and lifecycle rationale.
